topic: Accepting a 1099 contractor label as a full time employee vs challenging it (Abel vs Noor)

scenes.narration: Millions are illegally labeled contractors and quietly lose thousands. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding two paper labels reading EMPLOYEE and CONTRACTOR, comic burst banner reads MISLABELED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Abel and Noor work identical full time hours at one company.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man abel and woman noor at matching desks under a wall clock and a sign reading FORTY HOURS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both were hired as ten ninety nine independent contractors.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two hiring papers stamped TEN NINETY NINE CONTRACTOR on a manager's desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The boss sets their schedule, their tools, and every task.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a manager pointing at a strict schedule board while man abel and woman noor take orders, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That control makes them employees under the law, not contractors.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an open law book with a page reading CONTROL MAKES AN EMPLOYEE, a gavel resting on it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Abel says nothing and pays both halves of payroll tax.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man abel handing over two tax envelopes labeled BOTH HALVES, his wallet turned out empty, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He works sixty hours weekly and receives no overtime pay.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, exhausted man abel working at night beside a timesheet reading SIXTY HOURS NO OVERTIME, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Noor documents her schedule and files a status determination request.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman noor filing a form stamped WORKER STATUS DETERMINATION beside a folder of schedules, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Investigators rule she was an employee the entire time.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman noor reading an official letter with a seal reading RULED EMPLOYEE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She recovers nine thousand in back overtime and refunded taxes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman noor holding a large check stamped NINE THOUSAND BACK PAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Abel lost that same nine thousand by staying quiet.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man abel staring into an empty envelope labeled NINE THOUSAND LOST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Control decides your status, not the label. Save every schedule. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a comic banner reading THE LABEL IS NOT THE LAW, kids comic book illustration
